nodes.label: HostPulse
nodes.rationale: Windows-first hardware/OS benchmark for customer VMs; live diagnosis plus commercial offline HTML report as deliverable.

nodes.label: AuditResult
nodes.rationale: Versioned on-disk/in-memory audit contract; schema_version bumps on remove/rename; engine_version from bin/version.py.

nodes.label: Offline HTML report
nodes.rationale: Commercial priority deliverable; must open offline with no CDN on locked-down servers.

nodes.label: PRODUCTION_SAFE
nodes.rationale: Reduces CPU duration, disk MB, and IOPS iterations for production customer VMs.

nodes.label: Platform adapters
nodes.rationale: OS-specific probes in bin/plat.py; missing capability yields default/0 + PLATFORM_*_NA INFO, never crash.

nodes.label: FABLE+POWERS
nodes.rationale: Agent workflow order Memory→MCP→subagent→loop; HostPulse piece-checks before declaring done.

nodes.label: Report-first strategy
nodes.rationale: Approach 1: report is commercial priority; keep Python; hybrid .NET/WPF/WebView2 out as primary path due to Windows lock and Linux conflict.

nodes.label: Anti-Windows-lock rules
nodes.rationale: No WPF/WinUI/WebView2-only UI; Windows APIs behind platform adapters; identical report/JSON on Windows and Linux; packaging per-OS.

nodes.label: Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Owns test sequence, progress, cooperative cancel, and quick/production-safe/profile flags; GUI and CLI share it.

nodes.label: PDF export
nodes.rationale: HTML→PDF via headless Edge/Chrome print-to-PDF to avoid heavy PDF libs blowing up Windows build.

nodes.label: Phase 1
nodes.rationale: Commercial report + schema_version + offline HTML; done when report is client-sendable and JSON contract stable.

nodes.label: Phase 1b
nodes.rationale: PDF + cooperative cancel + minimal CLI; done when one-click PDF path and Cancel/Ctrl+C are useful.

nodes.label: Phase 2
nodes.rationale: Platform adapters + Linux best-effort; runs without crash with documented gaps.

nodes.label: Phase 3
nodes.rationale: Live UX polish / optional new Python shell only after report is already the product.
